detaileddescription.para: Invokes the example function and reports the execution status.
Runs the DMA core test. It sets up the DMA engine to receive and send packets, transmits a packet, and verifies it after loopback reception.

XST_SUCCESS if the example finishes successfully, or XST_FAILURE if the example fails.
XST_SUCCESS if Example finished successfully, or XST_FAILURE if Example failed. Runs the interrupt example test. It does the following:
Set up the output terminal if UART16550 is in the hardware build
Initialize the DMA engine
Set up Tx and Rx channels
Set up the interrupt system for the Tx and Rx interrupts
Submit a transfer
Wait for the transfer to finish
Check transfer status
Disable Tx and Rx interrupts
Print test status and exit

XST_SUCCESS if Test passed, or XST_FAILURE if Test failed. Runs the DMA core test. It sets up DMA engine to be ready to receive and send packets, then a packet is transmitted and will be verified after it is received via the DMA loopback widget.

XST_SUCCESS if Test passed, or XST_FAILURE if Test failed. Runs the interrupt example test. It does the following: Set up the output terminal if UART16550 is in the hardware build Initialize the DMA engine Set up Tx and Rx channels Set up the interrupt system for the Tx and Rx interrupts Submit a transfer Wait for the transfer to finish Check transfer status Disable Tx and Rx interrupts Print test status and exit

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS if Example finished successfully, or XST_FAILURE if Example failed.
